info.description:
New API relay contracts. Availability depends on configured channels/models and enabled task plugins. This is a selected API contract, not a complete route inventory. Provider-specific fields and modes are conditional; no third-party provider availability is implied.

Organization selection boundary: this operation has no organization-resource support. An explicit positive X-Organization-Id header or org_id query value returns 403 before resource lookup or upstream work. Malformed/reserved/duplicate selectors return 400; a header and query together return 400 even when equal. Absent selection or a single canonical 0 preserves the existing credential, body and resource rules. Unrelated legacy query bytes are preserved. Request-body fields do not select a local organization. The boundary does not grant authentication or authorize personal/platform resources. This also applies to undeclared methods, dynamic aliases and unmatched routes; it does not register additional endpoints. Framework slash/path redirects may precede middleware; following the redirect must preserve selection and cannot permit personal fallback. HEAD responses have no HTTP body. Non-/api boundary errors use the host relay envelope, including on Claude/Gemini routes.

post.description:
根据对话历史创建模型响应。支持流式和非流式响应。

兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions API。

With stream:true, the body is SSE (UTF-8 event/data lines separated by a blank line), not one JSON document. Comment heartbeats may occur. Chat/completion data frames contain JSON chunks; [DONE] is the terminal sentinel. Failures before response start can be HTTP JSON errors. After headers/body are committed, HTTP status cannot describe subsequent failure; inspect error/terminal events and transport termination. Abrupt termination is not a successful completion.

get.description: Upgrade to WebSocket, then send response.create JSON frames (top-level fields, or legacy response wrapper). response.cancel is accepted only for an active response; other client event types are rejected. Each create reruns authentication and model rate-limit middleware. A second concurrent create yields an error event with status 409. Errors before upgrade are HTTP responses; after 101, errors are JSON WebSocket events, not HTTP responses. OAS 3.0 models only the handshake: x-websocket contains message contracts; generated HTTP clients do not implement this transport.

post.description: Native DeepSeek Search only; requires an operator-configured eligible channel. The server-owned subject deepseek-search is fixed before token model authorization/channel distribution and remains the billing/log identity. Body model/group and administrator mapping/overrides cannot change that authority. Known outgoing fields remain validated after overrides. Default billing is one request at USD0.00075; count does not multiply it. Administrator expressions/legacy prices, explicit zero and group overrides remain authoritative. Responses are completely buffered and validated with a gateway 16MiB cap (not a provider limit), within a 30-second attempt deadline or an earlier caller/transport deadline. Only original valid nonempty HTTP200 settles. Empty/error refunds ordinary local reservation, subject to the separate existing violation-fee policy. Fully received original408/429/5xx may follow existing bounded retry policy; an ambiguous sent outcome, truncated/invalid200 or downstream delivery failure is never automatically replayed. Local refund is not proof of no provider charge; separate client requests have no provider idempotency guarantee. No tools/fetch, Responses fallback or provider availability is supplied. For legacy per-call prices this new endpoint uses fixed-expression rounding; an initial truncated reservation can be topped up by one quota unit. Non-trusted wallet top-ups reserve available quota atomically; existing trusted-session/subscription policies remain unchanged.

200.description: Complete valid native search response. Empty results refund the ordinary local reservation; nonempty results settle one fixed search request before delivery.

PersonalOrganizationHeader.name: X-Organization-Id
PersonalOrganizationHeader.description: Request-local organization selector, not a credential or access grant. Omit or use canonical "0" for personal context. Only ASCII canonical decimal 0 or a nonzero value without leading zeros, at most 9223372036854775807, is accepted. At most one header value or one org_id query value is allowed; supplying both is ORG_SELECTOR_CONFLICT even when equal. Duplicate values, empty values, comma lists, signs, whitespace remaining after HTTP parsing, leading zeros, fractions, exponents, overflow and reserved aliases are ORG_SELECTOR_INVALID. Header names are case-insensitive; the only accepted query name is org_id. Case variants and organization_id are rejected, including when their value is 0. Query names and selector values are decoded once, never recursively; relevant malformed escapes and raw-semicolon ambiguity are rejected. A matched organization path ID must be positive and equal a single optional header/query selector. Selection never changes a cookie or the login session. This operation only accepts absent selection or 0; an explicit positive selector returns 403.
